operation.title: Operation
operation.description: write: export an Apify dataset (or JSON rows) to the sheet. read: import a sheet tab or range into this run's dataset.

spreadsheet.title: Spreadsheet URL or ID
spreadsheet.description: Paste the Google Sheets URL (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/…). First share the spreadsheet with sheets-tool@apify-tools-512508.iam.gserviceaccount.com as Editor (Share button → paste the email → Editor → untick “Notify people” → Share). Not needed if you provide your own service account key below.

sheetName.title: Sheet tab name
sheetName.description: Tab to read or write. Leave empty for the tab in the URL (gid) or the first tab. When writing, a missing tab is created for you.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID (write)
datasetId.description: The Apify dataset to export, e.g. from a run's Storage tab. In an integration (run this actor after another actor finishes) use {{resource.defaultDatasetId}}.

writeMode.title: Write mode
writeMode.description: append: add rows below the existing data (new columns are added to the header). replace: overwrite the tab's contents with the dataset; old rows are cleared only after the new data is written.

deduplicateBy.title: Deduplicate by columns
deduplicateBy.description: Skip rows whose values in these columns already exist (in the sheet when appending, and within the data). E.g. url or id. Skipped rows are free. Works for read too.

columns.title: Columns (optional)
columns.description: Only these columns, in this order. Nested fields use dots, e.g. address.city. Leave empty for all fields.

arrayHandling.title: Arrays
arrayHandling.description: How to put arrays into cells: join simple lists with commas, store as JSON, or expand into numbered columns (tags/0, tags/1…).

valueInputOption.title: Cell values
valueInputOption.description: RAW stores text exactly as-is (safe: values starting with = are not run as formulas). USER_ENTERED lets Google parse numbers, dates and formulas like typing.

rawData.title: Raw data (write, instead of a dataset)
rawData.description: Optional JSON array of objects to write instead of a dataset, e.g. [{"name":"A","price":1}].

range.title: Range (read)
range.description: Optional A1 range within the tab, e.g. A1:F500 or B:D. Leave empty for the whole tab.

valueRender.title: Read values as
valueRender.description: FORMATTED_VALUE: what you see in the sheet (e.g. "$1.50"). UNFORMATTED_VALUE: raw numbers and booleans.

skipEmptyRows.title: Skip empty rows
skipEmptyRows.description: Ignore fully empty rows when reading.

headerRow.title: First row is a header
headerRow.description: Read: use row 1 as field names. Write: write/merge column names into row 1.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows (0 = no limit).

serviceAccountKey.title: Your own service account key (optional)
serviceAccountKey.description: Advanced: paste the full JSON key of your own Google Cloud service account (with Sheets and Drive APIs enabled). Then share your sheet with that account's email instead of ours. Stored encrypted as a secret input.
